title: WAN Demo — Interactive Rack View
description: The rack-cabling topology with the dense-map readability features enabled (plugin >= 1.5.12): hover a cable to highlight its whole path and fade the rest; power cables render as true one-way flows into the PSU inlets; value labels de-overlap automatically and hide when zoomed out two steps; a built-in status legend explains the colors; the PSU inlet labels are bold for emphasis.
